tasks.title: Normalize backend transcript assembly
tasks.description: Make SessionTranscriptAssembler the canonical boundary for historical transcript replay. It should produce stable turns, assistant parts, prompt summaries, normalized tool identity, file-change summaries, warnings, and aggregate metadata from persisted session events.
acceptanceCriteria: Same-second events are sorted deterministically so prompts open turns before assistant activity, tool_call precedes tool_call_update, and terminal events close turns last
Each mohist_prompt opens a turn and the next prompt or terminal event closes the previous turn
Tool identity is inferred from toolName, name, title, rawInput shape, and rawOutput metadata before falling back to unknown
Nested toolCall payloads, top-level ids, and no-id ACP start/update payloads merge into one stable tool part when inferable
apply_patch, edit, and write payloads produce file-level changedFiles summaries with operation and additions/deletions when available
Transcript metadata includes lastActivityAt, eventCount, toolCount, turnCount, changedFiles, warnings, and hasUnknownTools
Backend transcript unit tests cover same-second ordering, multi-prompt turns, nested/no-id tool merge, title/input tool inference, terminal closure, legacy fallback, and apply_patch summaries
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Produces the normalized transcript contract consumed by API and UI. Keep existing fields backward-compatible while adding normalized fields.

tasks.title: Expose enriched coder session detail API
tasks.description: Update the coder session detail API to return the enriched transcript and user-facing metadata produced by the assembler. The API should keep list/detail compatibility while exposing enough normalized data for the frontend to avoid re-inferring ordering or tool identity from raw logs.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/coder-sessions/:sessionId returns enriched metadata, normalized turns, incomplete marker, transcript warnings, changedFiles, and hasUnknownTools
The endpoint reads session_stream_log first and falls back to workflow_log stream events for legacy sessions
Fallback event filtering includes persisted Mohist prompt events where available
completedAt is null for non-terminal sessions and populated only for completed, failed, timeout, or cancelled sessions
API tests verify completed sessions can replay from persisted logs without SSE memory
API tests verify legacy sessions without prompts return an explicit incomplete synthetic turn instead of empty output
Existing coder session list consumers continue receiving the fields they currently use
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the enriched assembler output from T-001 and makes it the API contract for the session page.

tasks.title: Render prompt summaries and conversation speakers
tasks.description: Refactor the session transcript view so Mohist prompts are readable summaries by default and the transcript is explicitly labeled as Mohist/Coder conversation. Raw prompt text must remain available through a Show full prompt disclosure.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionTranscriptView renders speaker labels Mohist and Coder instead of generic Turn/Task labels
Mohist prompt cards show summary title, issue/output/context subtitle when available, sent time, and prompt kind
Full raw prompt content is collapsed by default and expands via Show full prompt
Long raw prompts no longer dominate the first screen in default collapsed state
Legacy missing prompts render a clear incomplete/legacy state without pretending a prompt exists
Assistant text still renders markdown, inline code, fenced code blocks, and lists correctly
Frontend tests cover prompt summary, raw prompt collapse, speaker labels, and legacy missing prompt rendering
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the prompt summary/raw prompt fields exposed by T-002. Keep the page read-only.

tasks.title: Render grouped context and todo tool parts
tasks.description: Compress noisy context-gathering tools into readable transcript groups while preserving expandable raw details. Todowrite should be summarized separately as todo-list progress rather than shown as a full raw payload by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Consecutive read, glob, grep, list, membrowse, memread, and memsearch tool parts render as a Context gathered group
Context gathered groups show human-readable counts such as read file count and searched pattern count
Context groups do not cross text, reasoning, error, or file-change boundaries
Expanded context groups show individual tool details and raw input/output for audit
Failed context tools are visible in the group summary and expandable detail
todowrite renders as Updated todo list by default and expands to todo detail when requested
Frontend tests cover context grouping, group expansion, failure visibility, and todowrite summary
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Builds on the conversation renderer from T-003. Grouping is presentation-only; do not remove individual tool parts from the transcript data.

tasks.title: Render file-changing tools as file summaries
tasks.description: Upgrade apply_patch, edit, and write rendering so users see file-level results before raw patches. The default view should show created, modified, deleted, or moved files with additions/deletions and allow raw patch or payload inspection on demand.
acceptanceCriteria: apply_patch tool cards show Patch or Files changed summary instead of raw patch text as the primary view
Add File, Update File, Delete File, and Move to patch operations render as created, modified, deleted, and moved file rows
edit and write tools render file path and additions/deletions or best-effort line counts when available
Raw patch, raw input, and raw output remain accessible behind disclosure controls
Failed file-changing tools show intended file targets and the failure message
Session or turn level changed files can be surfaced from transcript metadata where available
Frontend tests cover apply_patch patchText, title=apply_patch without toolName, write/create, delete, and raw patch expansion
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes changedFiles/file summary fields from T-001 and the grouped transcript rendering structure from T-004.

tasks.title: Improve session header and empty/error states
tasks.description: Update the session page chrome to communicate issue context, model, turn count, last activity, changed files, and user-facing status. Also distinguish loading, waiting for first activity, API error, empty history, stale session, and legacy missing-prompt states.
acceptanceCriteria: Session header shows issue link/title, stage, model, turn count, last activity, statusKind, and changed-file or artifact summary when available
Running sessions can display live, finalizing, or stale instead of only raw running status
Terminal sessions display completed or failed status with duration and last activity
Loading detail, API error, waiting first activity, no recorded activity, and legacy missing prompt are visually distinct states
Header does not show misleading completedAt or completed duration for running sessions
Frontend tests cover live, completed, failed, finalizing, stale, loading, empty, and API error states
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes API metadata from T-002 and changed-file summaries rendered by T-005.

tasks.title: Align live streaming with historical transcript shape
tasks.description: Refactor live transcript updates so SSE append behavior converges to the same transcript shape returned by historical refetch. Live text, tool updates, recovery events, completion, auto-scroll, and jump-to-bottom behavior should all operate on the normalized transcript model.
acceptanceCriteria: Live coder text appends to the active Coder part without creating a different shape from historical replay
Live tool start/update events use normalized tool identity and merge into the same tool part when ids are present or inferable
coder_session_completed, failed, timeout, and recovery events trigger detail refetch or equivalent reconciliation to canonical API transcript
When the user is near the bottom, text and tool updates follow the stream
When the user is not near the bottom, text and tool updates do not force-scroll and Jump to bottom appears
Clicking Jump to bottom restores follow mode and clears the new-content indicator
Live/historical parity tests prove append then refetch does not change transcript order or tool grouping for representative sessions
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Backend transcript remains authoritative; live state should be a temporary incremental view that reconciles after refetch.

tasks.title: Preserve prompt and tool data for replay
tasks.description: Ensure session event capture preserves the prompt metadata, tool identity fields, raw payload fields, file-change signals, and terminal state needed by the transcript assembler. This closes gaps where live payloads are visible temporarily but cannot be reconstructed after refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Persisted Mohist prompt events include full text, kind, title or role summary where available, output contract path where available, context files where available, and sent timestamp
Persisted or emitted tool events preserve toolName, name, title, rawInput, rawOutput, raw output metadata, status, and available ids
Terminal completion, failure, timeout, and cancellation events preserve enough status and timing data for transcript turn closure
A replay test proves a live-visible tool title/rawInput/rawOutput can be reconstructed after fetching persisted session detail
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes transcript normalization and live reconciliation work to verify the persisted event inputs are complete enough for replay.

tasks.title: Align session timeline entry points with transcript model
tasks.description: Ensure coder session surfaces outside the detail page point users into the readable transcript instead of exposing event-log-style tool rows as the primary experience. Issue-level session summaries should remain compact but make the detailed conversation replay easy to open.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening /issue/:number/session/:sessionId shows the conversation transcript as the primary view
Issue-level coder session summaries link to the detailed transcript page when session ids are available
Timeline or summary views do not duplicate noisy raw event-log tool rows as the primary coder-session representation
Frontend tests verify session summary links route to the transcript page where covered by existing test utilities
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keeps issue-level surfaces aligned with the session transcript model without redesigning the whole issue page.

tasks.title: Add realistic regression fixtures and final verification
tasks.description: Add or update regression fixtures that model real coder sessions and run final verification across backend, API, and UI. This task proves the completed page handles the #143 gaps and the issue #149 acceptance criteria together.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixtures cover a multi-turn plan session, a large Mohist prompt, many read/grep/glob context tools, apply_patch patchText, title=apply_patch without toolName, nested toolCall ids, and no-id tool start/update events
Regression tests prove inferable payloads do not render as unknown tool cards
Regression tests prove historical replay order remains stable across same-second events
Regression tests prove context tools group without hiding failures and file-changing tools show file-level summaries
Regression tests prove live append followed by refetch keeps equivalent transcript order and visible grouping
Regression tests prove error/recovery rendering and auto-scroll/new-content behavior
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Final verification consumes every earlier output. Keep fixtures local to tests unless a shared fixture directory already exists.
